The rep ran the standard verify sequence (address, title, utility, bill, roof, credit) without checking CRM/contact history first, which cost several minutes gathering data that had already been captured elsewhere. The transcript itself is degraded with crosstalk and likely speaker-attribution errors, which limits how much can be read into exact rep phrasing.
outcome_dispute: The v1 tag is unknown/unclear from metadata, but the observed outcome here is neither a fresh booking nor a clean DQ — it is a discovery that the customer is already scheduled with Ion. This should be tagged as a duplicate-contact / already-scheduled outcome, not treated as a standard no_appointment or DQ, since the underlying lead is still active and appointed elsewhere in the pipeline.
